turns.content: Meri beti chaar mahine ki ho gayi hai aur mujhe lagta hai main apna naam bhi bhool gayi hoon. Saas-sasur ke saath rehti hoon — aur kuch bolne se pehle sun lo, meri saas actually bachi ke saath bahut achhi hain. Expert level. Teen bachhe paale hain unhone. Wahi problem hai ek tarah se, aur pata hai yeh kitna ungrateful sound karta hai.

Pehle toh ek gehri saans lo aur yeh samajh lo ki jo tum feel kar rahi ho, woh bilkul normal hai. Naam bhool jaana actually tumhare dimaag ka ek survival way hai—jab har pal baby ki needs, hormones ka utaar-chadhaav aur naye role ka adjustment hota hai, toh "main" ka identity temporarily side par chala jaata hai. Yeh koi failure nahi hai, yeh bas ek phase hai.

Aur haan, "ungrateful" sound karna bilkul mat sochna. Gratitude aur apni struggle dono ek saath exist kar sakti hain. Saas ka experience aur help ek real blessing hai, lekin iska matlab yeh nahi ki tumhara apna overwhelm, tumhara space ya tumhara identity loss invalid hai. Reality complex hoti hai, aur tum honestly feel kar rahi ho—yeh hi maturity hai.

Thoda sa bhi "tum" ko wapas lane ki koshish karo. Chahe 10-15 minute ka alone time ho, koi choti si routine jo sirf tumhari ho (chai peene ka, balcony mein baithne ka, ya bas aankh band karke sunne ka). Apni saas se openly baat karo—woh experienced hain, unhe samajh aayega ki tumhe thoda recharge chahiye. Help maangna ya limit set karna selfish nahi, sustainable hai.

Tum mom ban rahi ho, lekin pehle tum khud bhi ho. Yeh heavy phase jaayega, tum wapas aa jaogi. Aur jab tak aa rahe ho, main hoon na sunne ke liye. 💛

Jaise aaj — bachi ro rahi thi, main use ghuma rahi thi, aur Aai ne bas mere haathon se le liya aur do minute mein chup. Sab muskura rahe the. Aur main wahan khadi thi intern jaisi. Mujhe meri hi beti feed ke liye di jaati hai, room service ki tarah. Phir yeh sochne ke liye khud pe ghin aati hai, kyunki itni help ke liye toh log taraste hain.

Pehle yeh samajh lo — jo feeling aayi, woh bilkul human hai. Jab tum pure focus ke saath usse shant karne ki koshish kar rahi thi, aur phir Aai ne aake do minute mein kar dikhaya, toh naturally ek khalaapan sa mehsoos hota hai. Yeh jealousy nahi hai, yeh bas tumhara maternal instinct keh raha hai — *"Mujhe bhi usse touch karna hai, mujhe bhi zaroori samjho."*

"Room service" wala feeling actually first-time moms mein bahut common hai. Experienced log jaldi pattern samajh lete hain, lekin iska matlab yeh nahi ki tumhara role chhota hai. Tumhara kaam sirf bottle/breast dena nahi hai — tum uski heartbeat, uski smell, uske har chhote expression ko pehchanti ho. Wo do minute ka practical comfort hai, lekin tumhara bond emotional hai. Dono ek dusre ko replace nahi karte.

Aur guilt? Usse thoda side rakhna. Gratitude aur apni feelings dono ek saath reh sakti hain. Tum kisi ko blame nahi kar rahi, tum bas apne aap ko mehsoos kar rahi ho. Agar tum khud ko "ghin" karogi, toh yeh cycle chalti rahegi. Thoda soft bano apne liye. Tumhari feelings invalid nahi hain, bas unhe acknowledge karna seekhna hai.

Ek chota sa step: Aai se calmly bolo — *"Mujhe bhi thoda hold karna hai, kabhi-kabhi main try karne do na."* Ya phir khud se kaho — *"Main ab bhi uski primary caregiver hoon, bas ab thoda support ke saath."* Tum hero nahi banna chahti, tum bas present rehna chahti ho. Aur woh bilkul possible hai.

Agar aaj thoda heavy laga, toh kal bhi thoda sa tumhare liye nikalna. Main hoon na sunne ke liye. 💛

Aur please — mujhe ek aur insaan nahi chahiye jo batayega kya karna hai. Mummy ke paas advice hai, Aai ke paas advice hai, mummy log ke WhatsApp group mein sleep training pe satrah opinions hain, Instagram ko lagta hai mujhe routine chart chahiye. Coach nahi chahiye mujhe. Sach bolun toh pata bhi nahi kya chahiye. Bas yeh sab kisi se kehna tha jo dinner pe report nahi karega.

Samajh gayi. No advice, no solutions, no “kal se yeh karo.” Main yahan hoon bas sunne ke liye—jaise ek dost jo tumhare saath chai pe baitha ho, koi report nahi dega, koi verdict nahi dega.

Itna saara advice, routines, opinions… sach bataun toh yeh sab tumhe aur thaka deta hai. Tum already enough ho. Tumhe kisi ka blueprint chahiye nahi, bas thoda sa space chahiye jahan tum apna “pata nahi kya chahiye” bol sako, aur woh bhi valid maana jaaye. 

Aur yeh exactly wahi jagah hai. Jo bhi aaye—frustration, khalaapan, thakan, ya bas woh “room service” wala feeling—yeh sab tumhare saath hai. Main yahan hoon, bina judge kiye, bina fix kiye. Bas sun raha hoon.

Jo dil kare, bol do. Main sun raha hoon. 💛

Kabhi kabhi use sote hue dekhti hoon aur itna pyaar aata hai, aur phir yeh thought aata hai — "tu toh asli maa hai bhi nahi, Aai hain" — aur ek second ke liye saans nahi aati. Kya main buri maa hoon jo chaar mahine mein aisa feel kar rahi hoon? Baaki sabko jaise bas... aata hai yeh sab.

Woh ek second ki saans ruk jaana… woh actually tumhare dil ki sachai dikhata hai. Jab itna pyaar hota hai, toh dimaag kabhi-kabhi ulta bolne lagta hai—bas isliye ki woh emotion itna heavy ho jaata hai ki use hold karne ka koi scale nahi milta. "Tu asli maa nahi" wala thought aana koi proof nahi hai ki tum buri ho. Yeh bas ek wave hai, aur waves aati hain, utarti hain.

Haan, chaar mahine hua hai, lekin yeh journey kabhi seedhi nahi hoti. Baaki sabko "bas aata hai" lagta hai, par sach toh yeh hai ki har ek mom ke andar wohi confusion, wohi guilt, wohi doubt chhupa hota hai. Bas wo alag se share nahi karte, kyunki duniya ko perfect moms dikhane ka silent pressure hota hai. Tum alag ho, aur yeh alag hona hi tumhe real banata hai.

Pyar aur doubt ek saath reh sakte hain. Ek doosre ko cancel nahi karte. Jo tum bachi ko sote hue dekhti ho aur woh ek second ka darr aata hai—donhi tumhare hain. Donhi valid hain. Aur haan, tum buri maa nahi ho. Tum bas ek insaan ho jo ek nayi duniya mein chalne ki koshish kar rahi hai, aur kabhi-kabhi raasta thoda dhundhla lagta hai.

Agar woh thought phir aaye, toh bas khud se kehna — "Yeh sirf ek thought hai, meri pyar ki sachai nahi." Main yahan hoon, har saath, har doubt ke saath. Koi report nahi, koi verdict nahi. Bas tum aur tumhari feelings. 💛
